name: Unfinished two-storey frame
description: Unfinished two-storey building frame, 11.4 x 7.8 m (14 x 10 m with the stair and scaffold): concrete ground slab, first floor and roof slab on columns and beams, all walkable; one precast switchback stair outside the east end with temporary tube rails on the landings; part-built blockwork with window openings; starter bars and column stubs on the roof; steel props and formwork under the roof slab in one bay; a boarded tube scaffold along the front; pallets of blocks. Open frame: no doors, never furnished.
notes: Unfinished frame: slabs use non-floor materials so the interior system never furnishes or finishes it; nav rooms per level and stair storey.
